# NPC Wojak

2016Image macro / exploitable characterclassic

Published March 10, 2026 · Updated March 23, 2026

Also known as: NPC meme · NPC · Grey Wojak

**NPC Wojak is a grey, expressionless variant of the Wojak meme character, designed to represent people perceived as lacking independent thought or an inner monologue.** The concept originated on 4chan's /v/ board in July 2016, but the distinctive grey-faced visual didn't appear until September 2018, when it exploded into one of the most politically charged memes of the Trump era[1](https://meme.com/memes/npc-wojak#ref-1).
